entities.name: Michał Bąkiewicz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michał Bogusław Bąkiewicz is a Polish former professional volleyball player and coach. He is a former member of the Poland national team, a participant in the Olympic Games Athens 2004, a silver medallist at the 2006 World Championship and the 2009 European Champion. He serves as a chairman of PGE Skra Bełchatów.

entities.summary: Michał Bogusław Bąkiewicz is a Polish former professional volleyball player and coach. He serves as a chairman of PGE Skra Bełchatów.
